messages.author: a798ae8eb83fb9a2
messages.subject: Error of besag model
parts:
Dear INLA developers,

When I run besag model, I got a warning message:

In INLA::f(idx, model = "besag", graph = NetAdj) :
  The graph for the model besag has 3 connected components!!! Model is revised accordingly.

Could anyone tell what the problem is and how should solve the problem?

Sincerely,
Xiaojun Pu

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error of besag model
parts: This is not a problem, just a warning. See this paper about a proper way to deal with such case: https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.04854
